Resolves #21389

A text field showing an in-flow error now puts the message under the input, and the input keeps its width. The field takes the grid a character-count field already uses (PR #20311), keyed on the error wrapper the DOM holds only while an error shows. Absolute errors (`errorPositionAbsolute`) keep the one-row flex layout. The selector sits in `:where()`, so the shared grid rule keeps the counter rule's specificity.

Intake: self-authored this session. Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css` owns the field's layout, and the DOM already carries whether an error shows, so no JavaScript changes.

Evidence: L3 (component specs in Chromium, red on `dev` and green at head; headless crops of the example before and after) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-5). Residual: AC-6, Residual-Owner: #21333.
